thread:
Jessie: quick check — need to finalize the burst-credit billing model and preempt/notice window for Dedicated GA. customers keep asking for hard guarantees but infra ops want flexibility.

Omar: agreed. ops perspective: prefer short notice (<=60s) to keep infra efficient. long windows cause unused reserved capacity.

Sasha: enterprise customers push back. some legal teams demand >=5min notice for critical flows. can we offer tiered notice windows?

Maria: propose tiering: Standard (60s default), Extended (5m, paid), No-Preempt (contracted, priced). billing must clearly separate committed capacity vs purchased notice/credits.

Alex: pricing models we sketched:
1) Committed vGPU-hours + dynamic daily burst credits (consumed first)
2) Prepaid burst blocks (e.g., 10 burst-hours/month) that smooth invoice
3) Overage pay-as-you-go for ad-hoc spikes

Jessie: which of those are minimal for GA? we can't ship with too many knobs.

Maria: GA must include at least model (1) + daily credits (2) for customers who want predictable billing. overage (3) can be phased in.

Omar: ops needs concrete preempt playbook in the runbook. suggested sequence: 1) preempt-notify -> 2) model-variant fallback -> 3) elastic buffer -> 4) public spill -> 5) force-preempt. include backoff windows and telemetry.

Sasha: customers want visibility. UX should show a "burst timeline" in the Console: prewarm, active, notice countdown, fallback action taken. also expose configurable fallback order per contract.

Alex: implementation notes: autoscaler needs a small API surface for "burst credits consumed" and "preemptable=true/false" per session. also want kernel-level drain tokens to avoid thundering herd when many tenants get preempted.

Maria: security ask: ensure fallbacks don't move requests between network zones in a way that could cross customer boundaries or PII scopes. need security signoff before GA.

Omar: operations checklist for GA:
- runbook + incident playbook
- telemetry: notice_sent, fallback_triggered, preempted_sessions_count
- automated postmortem hook when preempt > threshold

Sasha: sample autoscale + fallback config we can surface in Console (for advanced customers):
```
autoscale_policy: "committed_plus_burst"
committed_nodes: "8"
burst_headroom_pct: "25"
burst_credit_mode: "daily_pool"
fallback_sequence: ["variant-smaller","elastic-buffer","public-pool"]
preempt_notice_secs: "60"
```

Jessie: launch gating — what are must-have acceptance criteria?

Maria: GA gates (pass/fail):
- Console: SLA tier UI + burst credit billing item present
- Billing: accurate daily credit accounting and invoice line items
- Ops: validated runbook + test playbook (preempt simulation)
- Security: signed review on cross-pool data handling
- Eng: prototype of fallback path without session corruption
- Metrics: latency SLO maintained in 99th percentile under burst in at least 2 tests

Omar: add one more gate: preempt notice telemetry in prod-like tests to verify timing accuracy (jitter <5s).

Sasha: also ensure customers can opt into longer notice windows during contract onboarding. add a checkbox in the contract flow and Console enablement toggle.

Alex: dev tasks we should prioritize now:
- implement burst credit accounting API + DB schema
- basic fallback orchestration plumbing (config-driven)
- graceful drain tokens + kernel smoothing PoC
- Console mocks for timeline + tier selection

Jessie: OK. timeline & next steps: product to draft SLA tier doc and pricing bullets; eng to spike credit API + fallback PoC; ops to draft runbook tests; legal to draft contract language for Extended/No-Preempt options.

Deploy-bot: meeting scheduled: Dedicated Burst & Notice Windows sync — Thu 09:00 PT — https://cal.redwood/s/meet/98765

Jessie: thanks — I'll circulate an action checklist before Thu. ping me if you're blocked on legal or infra dependencies. :thumbsup:
